description: Target-gene log2 fold changes in GSE299627, DMD vs healthy myoblasts, with published FBN1/FBN2 values overlaid
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Values computed by analysis.py (PyDESeq2 0.6.0) on GSE299627; pasted here for plotting.
rows = [
("FBN1","fibrillin",-1.200377,3.360951e-12),("FBN2","fibrillin",-0.358358,1.105723e-01),
("LTBP1","LTBP/ECM",0.528487,5.859430e-04),("LTBP2","LTBP/ECM",-0.739096,2.236040e-06),
("LTBP3","LTBP/ECM",-1.316929,3.940713e-34),("LTBP4","LTBP/ECM",-0.702237,4.680953e-04),
("ZNF277","regulator",0.405990,3.847699e-02),
("ATP2A1","SR Ca handling",-0.816630,5.855714e-05),("ATP2A2","SR Ca handling",-0.150885,3.601850e-01),
("ATP2A3","SR Ca handling",-1.428539,5.503350e-04),("CASQ2","SR Ca handling",-5.301082,2.378143e-03),
("CALM1","SR Ca handling",0.283726,1.368724e-02),("CALM2","SR Ca handling",0.367661,5.657361e-03),
("CALM3","SR Ca handling",-0.227094,7.088594e-02),("RYR1","SR Ca handling",-7.584581,7.645772e-12),
("ITPR1","SR Ca handling",-0.965120,1.367549e-06),
("ORAI1","sarcolemmal entry",0.160785,3.711486e-01),("STIM1","sarcolemmal entry",-0.088438,6.048183e-01),
("TRPC1","sarcolemmal entry",0.629003,9.957477e-04),("TRPC3","sarcolemmal entry",-2.205082,3.318631e-06),
("PIEZO1","sarcolemmal entry",-0.256831,1.675653e-01),
("DMD","positive control",-0.431182,5.628217e-02),
]
df = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=["gene","class","log2fc","q"])
pal = {"fibrillin":"#2b6cb0","LTBP/ECM":"#63b3ed","regulator":"#805ad5",
       "SR Ca handling":"#dd6b20","sarcolemmal entry":"#38a169","positive control":"#718096"}
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8.5, 7))
y = np.arange(len(df))
ax.barh(y, df["log2fc"], color=[pal[c] for c in df["class"]], edgecolor="black", linewidth=0.4)
ax.set_yticks(y)
ax.set_yticklabels([g + (" *" if q < 0.05 else "") for g, q in zip(df.gene, df.q)], fontsize=9)
ax.invert_yaxis(); ax.axvline(0, color="black", lw=0.8)
ax.set_xlabel("log2 fold change, DMD relative to healthy (DESeq2 Wald)")
ax.set_title("GSE299627 target transcripts: DMD line AB1071 vs healthy line AB1190\n"
             "* BH q < 0.05. One cell line per group, so results are confounded with cell line.",
             fontsize=10)
ax.legend([plt.Rectangle((0,0),1,1,color=pal[k]) for k in pal], list(pal), fontsize=8, loc="lower left")
for i, (g, pub) in enumerate([("FBN1",-1.2),("FBN2",-0.9)]):
    j = int(df.index[df.gene == g][0])
    ax.plot([pub],[j], marker="D", color="red", ms=6, zorder=5)
ax.plot([],[], marker="D", color="red", ls="none", label="published value")
ax.text(0.02, 0.02, "red diamond = published log2FC (FBN1 -1.2, FBN2 -0.9)",
        transform=ax.transAxes, fontsize=8, color="red")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
print(df.to_string(index=False))
